tools.name: json_repair
tools.description: Fix broken or incomplete JSON, including text from language models.

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Turn text into Base64, or Base64 back into text. URL-safe and data URIs work too.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, and SHA-512 checksums of text.

tools.name: json_shaper
tools.description: Turn key-value lines, CSV, or a Markdown table into clean JSON.

tools.name: md_chunk
tools.description: Split Markdown into heading-aware chunks for search and RAG.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Line-level diff of two strings, plus a unified patch.

tools.name: yaml_json
tools.description: Convert a common YAML subset to JSON, or JSON to YAML.

tools.name: xml_json
tools.description: Convert XML to JSON, or a JSON object back to XML.

tools.name: html_sanitize
tools.description: Strip scripts and unsafe markup. Keeps a short allow-list of tags.

tools.name: date_timezone
tools.description: Parse a messy date and convert it to a timezone you choose.

tools.name: url_codec
tools.description: Percent-encode or decode a string or query map.

tools.name: unicode
tools.description: NFC, NFD, NFKC, or NFKD normalization, plus a character count.

tools.name: id_generate
tools.description: Create a UUID, ULID, or NanoID.

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description: Read a JWT header and payload. This does not check the signature.

tools.name: cron_parse
tools.description: Explain a 5- or 6-field cron string and list the next fire times in UTC.

tools.name: gtin_checksum
tools.description: Check or fill the check digit on a barcode number.

tools.name: sql_format
tools.description: Pretty-print a SQL query. This is a lightweight formatter, not a full SQL parser.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert length, mass, temperature, volume, time, area, speed, and data-size units.
